sections.heading: Unreal past: si + plus-que-parfait
sections.body:
To imagine a past that didn't happen, use *si* + **plus-que-parfait**, and the **conditionnel passé** in the other half:

- *Si j'avais su, je serais venu.* (If I had known, I would have come.)
- *Si tu m'avais appelé, je t'aurais aidé.* (If you had called me, I'd have helped you.)
- *Si nous étions partis plus tôt, nous n'aurions pas raté le train.*

sections.heading: Mixed: past condition, present result
sections.body:
If the condition is in the past but the result is **now**, use the **conditionnel présent** in the result:

- *Si j'avais accepté ce travail, je serais riche aujourd'hui.* (If I had accepted that job, I'd be rich today.)
- *Si tu avais dormi, tu ne serais pas fatigué maintenant.*

And the reverse — a present condition, a past result: *Si j'étais toi, je l'aurais dit.* (If I were you, I would have said it.)

sections.heading: The three si patterns
sections.body: Remember: never a conditional or a future right after *si* (meaning "if").

sections.heading: Other ways to express a hypothesis
sections.body:
- *avec* / *sans* + noun: *Avec un peu de chance, on aurait gagné.* (With a bit of luck, we'd have won.) *Sans ton aide, je n'y serais jamais arrivé.* (Without your help, I'd never have managed.)
- *au cas où* + **conditionnel** — in case: *Prends un parapluie au cas où il pleuvrait.* (Take an umbrella in case it rains.)
- *à condition de* / *à moins de* + infinitive (with the same subject — more at B2.6).
- *En cas de* + noun — in case of: *En cas d'urgence, appelez le 112.*

examples: Si j'avais su, je serais venu.
If I had known, I would have come.
Si tu m'avais appelé, je t'aurais aidé.
If you had called me, I'd have helped you.
Si nous étions partis plus tôt, nous n'aurions pas raté le train.
If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
Si j'avais accepté ce travail, je serais riche aujourd'hui.
If I had accepted that job, I'd be rich today.
Si tu avais dormi, tu ne serais pas fatigué maintenant.
If you had slept, you wouldn't be tired now.
Si j'étais toi, je l'aurais dit tout de suite.
If I were you, I would have said it straight away.
Avec un peu de chance, on aurait gagné.
With a bit of luck, we'd have won.
Sans ton aide, je n'y serais jamais arrivée.
Without your help, I'd never have managed.
Prends un parapluie au cas où il pleuvrait.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
En cas d'urgence, appelez le 112.
In an emergency, call 112.
Si elle avait saisi l'occasion, sa vie aurait été différente.
If she had seized the opportunity, her life would have been different.
Qu'est-ce que tu aurais fait à ma place ?
What would you have done in my place?
